post.summary: Search scoped knowledge with keyword/vector ranking
post.description: Minimum role: viewer. V3 instance and environment scope apply. Keyword and vector candidates use the same current explicit environment, active application mapping and V3 environment/knowledge grants. A document carrying team_id must match the application current owner team and have an additional team knowledge grant. Candidate document ID/version and current grants are rechecked before output; malformed or unknown scope and legacy source_registration_id documents are excluded pending trusted provenance. A separately stored, credential-free, single-page public HTTPS Markdown body can supply bounded keyword passages only when its latest read observation, content hash, revision, application/environment/team binding and current grants all match at candidate and final output checks. One 30-second budget covers the whole search, and more than 80 SQL-matched public Web sources across all visible application/environment scopes returns 413 public_web_source_scope_too_large. No public Web vector indexing, Agent tool, source page DTO or full source index is proven. When embeddings are unavailable, returns a keyword result with degraded=true; an unavailable keyword index returns 503.

post.summary: Change own local password and revoke all own sessions

New passwords contain 8–128 Unicode characters and require ASCII uppercase and lowercase letters, ASCII digits, and at least one Unicode punctuation or symbol character; invalid values return 422 invalid_password. Existing password input retains the 1024-byte login cap, without applying new password complexity rules. Directory source is metadata, not SSO: any active identity with a valid local password hash may change it. No configured local password returns 422 no_local_password. Wrong current password returns 422 incorrect_password, preserving the session. Successful hash update, all-user-session revocation and secret-free audit are transactional; response expires the current cookie. A new login is required.

get.summary: List configuration promotion records or merged candidates
get.description: Minimum role: viewer. V3 instance and environment scope apply. Read-only four-kind list for runbook, alert_rule, agent_version and sanitized canvas template. Non-production lists up to 100 signed persisted exports by the current authenticated actor in selected authorized environments. Current kind-specific access is rechecked after remote reads: Runbooks require the governed document lifecycle, team scope and recorded source revision; application-bound items require active application/environment bindings, and alert rules also allow the owner-team grant. Exported means a recorded open MR. Production requires a human platform administrator with global workspace.manage and reads a bounded, complete target-branch merged MR page, including promotions whose mutable label was removed. After remote reads, production rechecks global manager authority; both tiers recheck the exact live Cookie session and active account before returning the list. Before status merged or imported is reported, the exact single changed file at the immutable merge commit must match its kind-specific allowlisted path and trusted signed manifest; non-production merged status must also match the local export record. Imported is currently reachable only for templates and requires a matching import ledger, production target content and successful audit. This read does not enable promotion/import writes for the other three kinds or prove branch governance at merge time. Missing repository or source signing/trust configuration returns 501; unverifiable provenance returns 503; an over-limit list returns 413. Frontend state text and navigation require separate integration.

post.description: Minimum role: viewer. V3 instance and environment scope apply. A second concurrent reply is rejected with 409. The user message, canonical Upload references, selected model/reasoning, acceptance audit and private image/PDF byte snapshots are durable in one transaction before 202. Persisted uploads are rechecked in that transaction for exact owner, environment, reference metadata, MIME and bytes. Paste and safe UTF-8 .txt/.log/.conf/.toml/.md/.csv/.json/.yaml/.yml files enter a private bounded text snapshot (16 KiB source, 32 KiB snapshot). A link is fetched before acceptance only when it is public HTTPS Markdown with at most 1000 URL bytes, no query or fragment, and port 443; SSRF-protected fetch rejects private addresses, redirects, other content and oversized text. The fetched body is frozen in the private text snapshot and never refetched for a model retry or later turn. Upload storage accepts broader HTTP/HTTPS URLs, so an uploaded link can still be rejected at send. Internal Grafana/Kibana/GitLab links are not parsed through connector credentials and return 422 when not publicly readable Markdown. PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP images and PDFs are supplied as bounded media input on explicitly capable OpenAI Responses models (8 MiB aggregate raw bytes across the replayed conversation). An incapable model or unsupported type returns 422 before a turn is created, including when switching models with prior media in history. Invalid references or unsupported link content return 422; excessive attachment source/snapshot, media bytes or known text budget return 413; a genuine link fetch failure returns 503 before a turn exists. All turns precheck saved history plus the new message before 202; image/PDF token cost and the full system/tool request remain provider-authoritative and can still fail after acceptance. Start and terminal writes recheck the persisted owner, environment, initiating session and current V3 conversation authorization in their transactions. A revoked terminal turn drops partial output rather than saving it. SSE reply_id pins durable event replay; failures persist a terminal status and release the conversation for a new turn. A single-environment row includes an additive save snapshot with exact service/environment IDs, binding revision and persisted binding identities only for callers with current services view/change and connectors view/manage; unsupported or duplicate stored categories set editable=false. Each of 1-50 distinct service and service-environment identities replaces its complete mapping set using a current binding_revision; stale or changed identities return 409. Changed items, their revision increments and audit are committed atomically; an identical item returns its current revision. Empty body, display-only cells and duplicate or unknown system IDs are rejected. A code GitLab binding may only be retained when identical to the persisted binding; new or changed GitLab mappings must use discover/accept. Other bindings must pass the configured runtime binding validator. Current services view/change and connectors view/manage grants and the active session are rechecked in the transaction. The response contains persisted binding identities and post-write revisions. The frozen frontend still sends an empty PUT and cannot use this route until it submits the versioned request.

Each candidate includes an opaque ID, monotonic review version, exact service/environment/connector/target identity, binding revision and expiry; no binding is changed. source_state=not_configured distinguishes an absent supported source from a configured source with zero candidates. Distinct metric bindings return 409 ambiguous_binding. One bounded one-hour source read must cover the baseline plus 36 visible bin ends for every labeled panel. Request total must conserve 2xx/4xx/5xx and independently observed other statuses must be zero; SLO budget must agree with monthly availability and persisted request-based target; heat intensities must be normalized to 0..1.
